timeouts.cause: The for (;;) body becomes empty, removing reader.read(), the done check and break. Once this body is reached, the mutated loop cannot advance or terminate.
The untracked-line loop decrements i, retains only an upper-bound condition and uses defaults for missing entries; negative indices do not make progress toward the bound.
The line loop decrements i; missing entries fall back to an empty string. The loop no longer advances toward its upper bound and the line-count cap does not advance on that path.
The while body becomes empty, removing every update to i. A nonempty input remains at the same index.
For ordinary status/path records, reversing the status increment cancels the later path increment, repeating the same record.
For rename/copy records, the two-path advance is reversed; the parser goes backward instead of moving to the next record. The observed covered tests include rename/copy cases.
For ordinary records, reversing the path increment cancels the preceding status increment, repeating the same record.
The scan index becomes negative while its upper-bound condition remains true. charCodeAt at negative indices yields NaN rather than ending the scan.
effective is at least 1, but the batch index is decremented. Eventually slices remain empty and await Promise.all([]) repeats without reaching the upper bound.
The inner batch-result copy decrements j with no lower-bound exit, so it cannot advance to batch.length.
The record stride changes from +LOG_FIELDS to -LOG_FIELDS. Eventually empty slices parse to null and the loop continues toward negative indices.
The trailing-& scan decrements i while checking only i <= trailingAmpIndex. Negative indices yield undefined for character comparisons and cannot reach the trailing marker.

gainedKills.mechanism: 将下一个 child 搜索起点的加法改成减法，会把搜索起点移回已遍历区域，使相同 codespan 错配到之前出现的位置。新完整输出断言检出错位/丢失；旧子串与 marker 断言存在盲点。

data.conclusion: No observed loss in the frozen determinate population; two Survived-to-Killed gains. All 18 Timeout identities remain unresolved by the strict gate, with original statuses retained. This is bounded evidence for the sampled modules/tests, not a universal capability guarantee.
limitations: 原 strict aggregate ok:false 保留，18 Timeout 均仍 inconclusive。
id32 的具体超限调用未定位；有限递归放大是源码和 mocks 支持的候选解释。
其余17项描述覆盖输入上的失去进度路径，不声称每个输入都必定无限循环。
hit-limit 记录不提供对应墙钟耗时；没有把它们改标为 Killed。
749个双方可判定 mutant 未见检出下降；55 NoCoverage 仍未覆盖，18 Timeout 未决，结论限于冻结822个样本和列明测试集合。
2个gain说明输出契约的现有覆盖变得更严格，不代表全core的统一质量增幅。
